description: Rule-based price range (low/mid/high, EUR) for a used car from its VIN or Dutch plate (or make/model/year), mileage, condition and the approximate price when new. Not a valuation; it explains every step and the typical dealer gap. Polish listings are priced in PLN by the seller; this estimate is always in EUR, never converted. Nothing is stored.

newPrice.description: Approximate price when new in EUR (needed when the decoder has no list price)

vehicle.description: Instead of VIN/plate or as overrides: make, model, year, firstRegistration (YYYY-MM-DD), listPrice

name: estimate_price
title: Estimate a used-car price
